original_error: KeyError nonce after original schema validation
cause: Root intake incorrectly assumed a nonce field in the diagnostic payload. The reviewed production schema deliberately contains only schemaVersion, overflow and events; the nonce binds the private source filename, not payload.
correction: Use the unchanged exact-source validator and preserve original source-bound private filename/ownership attestation; do not invent a payload field or weaken validation. Complete local extraction from the one already downloaded and digest-verified ZIP.
